title: PIT net share issuance conditioning: short recent diluters, long flat/retiring share counts, within-sector on the multi-vintage SEC panel

mechanism_question.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow: Passive index funds and benchmarked managers are mechanically forced to absorb newly issued shares to hold constant index/benchmark weights, and they do so at calendar rebalances rather than at filing time; discretionary investors are slow to re-scale per-share valuation metrics (EPS, book-per-share) after a cover-page share-count change because dilution arrives as a small cover-page number, not a headline event.
mechanism_question.why_the_effect_exists: External equity supply is manager-timed (Baker-Wurgler 2002): firms issue when insiders perceive shares richly valued, so the marginal buyer must be compensated with a price concession; mechanically, a larger share count divides future cash flows across more claims, and the literature documents persistent underperformance of issuers (Loughran-Ritter 1995; Pontiff-Woodgate 2008) that survives because the supply shock is low-salience and arbitraged only by calendar-rebalanced systematic capital.
mechanism_question.what_observable_measures_it: The 12-month log change in dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding, read PIT as the as-of vintage at decision t versus the same funded clock evaluated one year earlier, on the multi-vintage panel (never latest-in-store).
mechanism_question.when_it_must_fail: (a) If the premium is a stale-data artifact it dies when the age bound is tightened from <=400 to <=120 days; (b) if it is a size/liquidity artifact it fails the ADV63 >= 2_000_000 eligibility screen or concentrates only in band C names and dies at stress cost; (c) if it is a label artifact rather than a supply event, the authorized-shares placebo reproduces the sort and the family is falsified; (d) if it is sector beta, risk-matched SPY and sector-ETF excess go non-positive in >= 2 folds.
mechanism_question.what_control_kills_convenient_explanatio: The us-gaap:CommonStockSharesAuthorized 12-month change placebo: it moves the same equity-structure label surface (same filings, same cover/balance-sheet section) without any share-supply event; if it reproduces the anchor spread, the convenient explanation 'any equity-structure label change predicts returns' wins and the family is abandoned, no rescue.

falsifiable_prediction: Within the P3-eligible universe and within each panel sector label s, the top issuance quintile (fastest 12m growth of dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding) underperforms the bottom quintile (flat/contracting counts) over the following quarter on a long-short book. Preregistered pass conditions are exactly the Stage-A gates of p3_invariants_freeze.json: expectancy > 0, position PF >= 1.1, >= 2 of 3 folds positive, max fold MDD <= 0.15, risk-matched SPY excess positive in >= 2 folds, anchor overall alpha > 0, and placebo |alpha| < 0.5 x anchor |alpha|. The prediction is falsified if any gate fails, if the <=400-day age bound to <=120-day bound swap flips or destroys the sign, or if the authorized-shares placebo reproduces the anchor.
literature: Loughran, T. and Ritter, J. (1995), 'The New Issues Puzzle', Journal of Finance 50(1)
Baker, M. and Wurgler, J. (2002), 'Market Timing and Capital Structure', Journal of Finance 57(1)
Daniel, K. and Titman, S. (2006), 'Market Reactions to Tangible and Intangible Information', Journal of Finance 61(6)
Pontiff, J. and Woodgate, A. (2008), 'Share Issuance and Cross-Sectional Returns', Journal of Finance 63(2)
McLean, R.D., Pontiff, J. and Watanabe, M. (2009), 'Share Issuance and Cross-Sectional Returns: International Evidence', Journal of Financial Economics 94(1)
Fama, E.F. and French, K.R. (2005), 'Financing Decisions: Who Issues Stock?', Journal of Financial Economics 76(3)

pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.panel: .staging_sec_v8/multivintage_panel.jsonl (3,817,158 records / 410 filers, sha256 1cb115d3...); row schema {e, s, f, u, v, eff, avail}

anchor_clock_verbatim.clock: latest filed vintage as of t with age <= 400 days

robustness_leg_clock_verbatim.clock: latest filed vintage as of t (unbounded)

neighbour_clock_verbatim.clock: latest filed vintage as of t with age <= 400 days

placebo_clock_verbatim.clock: latest filed vintage as of t with age <= 400 days

pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.signal: signal(t) = ln( SO_asof(t) / SO_asof(t - 1y) ), where SO_asof(x) is the newest vintage of the cited field with avail < session_gate_utc(x) and age <= 400 days (identical funded clock evaluated at both legs; t-1y = the census decision date four quarters earlier)
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.availability_semantics: gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session (research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.session_gate_utc, conditioning-lag rule: availability stamp plus one session); SEC filed dates are date-only so availability is the end of the filed UTC day (conservative); a decision at t never reads a row with avail >= gate(t) and never reads latest-in-store; census facts for the anchor field: 380/410 filers with any history, 23,140 records, availability lag mean 12.74 / p50 7 / max 681 days, at-end coverage 0.9244 (p0a_coverage_census.json)
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.prices: EODHD RAW daily bars readable at session close + 1 session (p3 v8 availability_convention); ADV63 = median(close*volume) over 63 sessions ending at the decision session

aggregation_declaration.note: No SectorObservation / math.fsum sector aggregate is consumed by this design: the anchor is a per-name rank. The panel row sector label s (frozen 11-sector ETF mapping XLB/XLC/XLE/XLF/XLI/XLK/XLP/XLRE/XLU/XLV/XLY, research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.SECTOR_UNIVERSE) is used only to demean ranks within sector.

conditional_declaration_if_sector_aggreg.aggregation: single-vintage equal-weight mean over sorted filers via math.fsum, coverage = filers_included/filers_mapped reported per observation (p3 pit_conditioning_v5 semantics)

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.eligibility_per_p3_floor: filer in the frozen 410-filer panel (sha256 1cb115d3...) AND servable per p2_coverage_first.json per_name (409 priced names; cohort reconciliation 373 ACTIVE_FILER + 37 TERMINATED_REGISTRATION, 409 with price files, 1837 S0 sessions) AND ADV63 >= 2_000_000 USD (band C or better) at the decision AND RAW price >= 1.00 USD at the decision; p2 band populations cited, not assumed: start {A:286, B:94, C:10, UNTRADABLE:4, NO_DATA:15}, mid {A:307, B:87, C:11, UNTRADABLE:3, NO_DATA:1}, end {A:376, B:31, C:1, UNTRADABLE:1}
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup: the prior-year leg requires a vintage of the same field with avail < gate(t-1y); at the first four S0 decisions (2018-04-04 through 2019-01-03) this leg is pre-S0 panel history and its per-name coverage is not measured by the census (reported at scoring, not assumed); from 2019-04-04 both legs are measured census dates; names lacking either leg at a decision are excluded at that decision only, never backfilled
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.rebalance_clock: quarterly on the 30 census decision dates (2018-04-04 .. 2025-05-23), the exact dates on which the cited FUNDED_CANDIDATE clocks were measured; per-fold decisions 10 / 10 / 10
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding_period: one quarter per decision (~63 sessions), continuous re-formation with rank buffers (quintile membership carried unless the name exits its quintile band or fails eligibility)
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.fills: signals computed on session t close data (PIT); fills at the next allowed session open-adjacent close-to-close execution (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK); no same-session fill; costs charged exactly once per side, no sidecar repetition

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.anchor: 12m log growth of dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding (funded clock age <= 400), long bottom-issuance quintile / short top-issuance quintile, demeaned within panel sector s
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.neighbour_mechanism: identical construction on us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued (funded clock age <= 400, pooled coverage 0.7576): a different equity-structure label measuring the same share-supply channel from the balance-sheet share table instead of the dei cover; neighbour SUPPORTS the family only if same sign, and its coverage-floored 0.8-floor miss (0 dates at the 0.8 floor) is a declared, documented weakness — the neighbour is thinner, which is exactly why it is the neighbour and not the anchor
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.placebo_causal_control: 12m change of us-gaap:CommonStockSharesAuthorized (funded clock age <= 400, pooled coverage 0.846), same portfolio form
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.intended_correlation_profile_L7: The placebo change-series is sparse and legal-ceiling-bound: most filers show zero annual authorized-count change and an authorization event creates no outstanding-share supply, so its ranks are expected to be near-orthogonal to the anchor's dense issuance ranks and its long-short spread is expected to be economically null (|alpha| < 0.5 x anchor alpha per p3 control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt). It shares the filing label surface with the anchor while removing the supply event, so a reproduced spread would isolate 'label change' as the driver and falsify the family. The control's correlation profile is declared ex ante here; it is never argued post hoc.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.falsification_rule: if the placebo reproduces the anchor spread, or if the stale-rank variant (anchor leg lagged one extra year, diagnostic only, never traded standalone) outperforms the fresh anchor, the family is recorded FAIL with no rescue variant

incremental_alpha_test.vs_spy: incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context, SPY total return (adjusted path) scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule; reported per fold and overall; gate risk_matched_excess_positive_folds_ge 2 and anchor_overall_alpha_gt 0
incremental_alpha_test.vs_sector_etf: benchmark excess vs the equal-weight total return of the frozen 11 sector ETFs (SECTOR_UNIVERSE XLB..XLY, authorized EODHD data), book vs its within-sector-demeaned construction; the sector-ETF leg is a measurement benchmark, never a traded momentum leg (A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM stays closed)
incremental_alpha_test.gates: expectancy > 0; position PF >= 1.1; >= 2 of 3 folds positive; min populated fold PF >= 0.8; max fold MDD <= 0.15 (not negotiable); margin-to-fail reported for every gate on a survivor (P-2)

base_and_stress_costs.model: p3 v8 liquidity-band cost model: bands by trailing 63-session median dollar volume as-of each decision; cost linear in fills, applied to BOOKED PnL, never a sidecar
base_and_stress_costs.expected_blended_estimate_from_cited_ban: panel-weighted base per side = start (286x10 + 94x15 + 10x25)/390 = 11.6 bps; mid (307x10 + 87x15 + 11x25)/405 = 11.3 bps; end (376x10 + 31x15 + 1x25)/408 = 10.4 bps; stress = 2x each (20.8-23.2 bps per side). These are arithmetic blends of the cited p2 band populations, not measured arm composition; scoring reports the realized band mix.
base_and_stress_costs.annual_drag_estimate: at declared expected two-way turnover <= 3.0/yr, base drag <= ~35 bps of gross, stress <= ~70 bps of gross

turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_convention: sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (V3 ADJ-5 corrected), annualized two-way, raw and ceiling-normalized both reported
turnover_and_sample_floor.declared_expectation: quarterly decisions on an annual-growth signal with quintile buffers: expected two-way turnover <= 3.0/yr, binding ceiling 6.0/yr; signal updates only when a new vintage beats the gate (~quarterly per filer)
turnover_and_sample_floor.sample_floor: 30 quarterly decision dates total (>= 30 scored decisions, p3 min_decisions_total), 10 per fold (>= 5 per fold, p3 min_positions/min decision periods); at least 1 non-CASH leg per decision or the decision abstains
turnover_and_sample_floor.accounting: long/short books separate, gross/net/cash reconciled to 1.0 within 1e-9; CASH never a symbol; no cross-fold carry

mandated_by_p3: drop-one symbol: value_book rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival = after-drop expectancy > 0
drop-one fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival = min > 0
drop_one_design.ingredient_drop_one: rerun the anchor book with dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding removed and only the neighbour us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued driving ranks (verifies the mechanism is not a single-label artifact); additionally rerun with the age bound tightened 400 -> 120 days (stale-vintage artifact check)
drop_one_design.no_post_hoc_arms: all reruns above are declared here, ex ante; no additional arm may be added after any PnL is scored

failure_interpretation.anchor_fail_neighbour_pass: label-specific artifact in the dei cover field; family recorded FAIL for the anchor, neighbour recorded as evidence only
failure_interpretation.placebo_reproduces: exposure-form result (any equity-structure label change predicts) - family falsified, no re-parameterization, no rename, no rescue variant
failure_interpretation.pass_only_in_band_C: liquidity-cost artifact; stress rerun at 2x band cost must also pass or the arm is recorded FAIL
failure_interpretation.all_failures: carry margin-to-fail reporting per LESSONS P-2

source_to_test_map.fundamentals: .staging_sec_v8/multivintage_panel.jsonl rows filtered on f in {dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding, us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued, us-gaap:CommonStockSharesAuthorized}; as-of selection via select_asof with usable_for_session/avail < gate(t); bridge research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.py untouched
source_to_test_map.prices_and_eligibility: .staging_prices_v8/eod (EODHD RAW, 409 files sha256-pinned in p0a_eodhd_price_manifest.json) for ADV63 bands, RAW >= 1.00 check, and fills; servability from p2_coverage_first.json per_name

forbidden_inventory_screen.A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM: CLEAN - no sector-ETF momentum anywhere; ETFs appear only as (i) the frozen sector label s for rank demeaning and (ii) an optional measurement benchmark in the incremental test; no price lookback of any kind enters the signal
forbidden_inventory_screen.A5-SFV2-TREND-DEFENSIVE: CLEAN - no SMA/EMA/trend filters, no vol targeting, no defensive rotation
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL: CLEAN - no idiosyncratic price shock, crash or overshoot term; the signal never reads prices
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV3-A6-TOM-SETTLE: CLEAN - no turn-of-month/settlement calendar timing; the ~quarterly census decision dates are the dates on which the funded clocks were measured, and the mechanism is corporate share supply, not calendar seasonality
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV4-A5-H1-PARTICIPATION-SHIFT: CLEAN - no dollar-volume shock, no fresh-vs-stale participation term; ADV63 is used only for P3 eligibility and cost banding, never as a signal or rank
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHARE_and_vol_le: CLEAN BY CONSTRUCTION AND COMMITTED TO MEASUREMENT - no variance, semivariance or vol-level term; anchor ranks are built solely from filed fundamentals, sharing zero source fields with the V4 semivariance-SHAPE anchor or the V4 vol-level control, so the V6 measured-closed region (rho 0.319 > 0.20) is not entered by design; nonetheless a pre-selection A7-N rank-correlation check vs BOTH the V4 semivariance-SHAPE anchor feature/rank and the V4 vol-level control is committed, and the arm is abandoned if |rho| > 0.20 measured before any selection
forbidden_inventory_screen.EQ_S2_A3_F1_PIT_RECON_FLOW: DISTINCT - that frozen family is PIT reconstruction/flow (fund-flow reconstruction, never scored); this proposal uses as-of filed fundamentals growth from the frozen 154-clock set (the exact channel the V8 packet mandates), reconstructs no investor flow and consumes no flow data
forbidden_inventory_screen.A5-S2-F1-LENDING-CONSTRAINT-PREMIUM: CLEAN - no securities-lending, borrow or short-interest data
forbidden_inventory_screen.generic_mechanisms: CLEAN - no cross-sectional price momentum, no time-series trend, no earnings surprise/analyst revisions/institutional flows/quote-spread terms, no daily-indicator grid (one distinct economic mechanism on 30 quarterly decisions), no new accounts/paid data/network fetch
forbidden_inventory_screen.blocked_channels: CLEAN - only SEC EDGAR (multi-vintage panel) and EODHD All World (authorized, all six gates pass) are read; Massive Basic, Stooq bulk and per-symbol, and Twelve Data are not touched
forbidden_inventory_screen.rescue_variant_check: this is not a renamed V2/V3/V4/V5 family and not a fundamentals label on a price/volume mechanism: the anchor signal is a function of filed share counts only, verifiable by ablation (price inputs ablated -> signal unchanged)

implementation_estimate.code: ~450-650 LOC on top of the untouched PIT bridge: panel filter, per-filer as-of vintage path on the 30 census dates, two-leg growth signal, quintile books with buffers, eligibility/band join, book accounting per p3; reuses existing factory conventions
implementation_estimate.cells: 1 anchor + 1 neighbour + 1 placebo + 2 stress reruns (base/stress applied inside the same scored cells per p3) + drop-one reruns; serial cells within the family; each cell well inside the 120-minute hard timeout on the staged 3.8M-row panel (two-field row filter)
implementation_estimate.risk: pre-S0 prior-year legs at the first four decisions have unmeasured coverage (reported at scoring); dei cover-page share counts can lag corporate actions - mitigated by the <=400-day age bound and the 120-day tightening rerun; no new data dependencies

attestation: I wrote these proposals without access to any V8 scored outcome, any per-arm artifact, or any parameter search over returns; my only inputs were this packet and the committed evidence files it cites. — A5 (inlined light lane), 2026-09-05
